name: claims
line: the claims made in this session, deduped and grouped by what the work is doing, each with what exactly it means and where it was said
writer: the observer's one fork after each turn of work gives the turn's claims, each with what it means (precisely, based_on, judgment, unstated), and claims.js applyTurn places, dedupes, links and clusters them; the corpus orientation (a subagent of main, guided by SKILL.md) adds the corpus's claims with `thimble verb claims save`
offer: estimate.mjs: the time and tokens of the corpus orientation, which /verb claims orient asks Claude to start

forms.terminal: c: the claims pane (panes/claims.js), an island of dots per cluster; the claim the ring is on shows a card of what it means and its links; r replays the graph in the order the claims were made
forms.browser: Files › Claims: the same program on the same store and state; pointing at a claim shows its card and its links; a click on the claim shown opens the message where it was said; r replays the graph

keys.c: open or close the claims graph
keys.arrow keys: move the ring from claim to claim
keys.r: replay the graph in the order the claims were made (any key stops it)
